block.projectexa.transmutation_interface: This can be used with compatible mods like Applied Energistics to access your transmutation inventory.
block.projectexa.compact_sun.tooltip: The power of the sun in a single block.
block.projectexa.compact_sun.tooltip2: When put above or below certain blocks, multiplies their output by %s.
